description: This is a Kotlin source file defining a RecyclerView adapter (RecipeCardAdapter) for displaying recipe cards in a TV-optimized grid layout, including diff util callbacks, view holder class, and binding logic.

classes.name: RecipeCardAdapter

methods.description: Binds recipe data to the view holder at the given position.
